method: Fresh independent semantic source adjudication of all 63 answers from each reader. Each answer is graded by its own text; support labels and evidence labels are not grades, and no answer borrows material from another answer.

grading.correct: Every requested material part is resolved with no material contradiction. Semantically equivalent wording and ordinary default-rule answers do not require every key embellishment.
grading.partial: At least one requested material part is omitted or expressly unresolved, with no material source contradiction.
grading.incorrect: A material assertion contradicts the source.

input_boundary: No other iterations, evaluator grades or reports were read. Filenames returned by an initial repository file listing were not read as content.
source_limitations: Rulebook page 19 graphic payout numerals are not represented in the text extraction. Positive payout schedules were cross-checked against the permitted answer key and summary snapshot; all prose qualification and semantic scope decisions were checked against the complete extracted source.

questions.question: While you control the territory containing your Mill, how does it affect the number of territories you may Produce on and the output there, including when no actual worker is present?

Actual workers' additional production is therefore material. B's three-total phrase is read as the ordinary two-territory-plus-Mill illustration, not an explicit upgraded cap: it first states the correct additional-bonus rule and never says an upgrade cannot increase the normal allowance.
